binding_assessment.explanation: The manager confirmation creates or replays the durable job first. The confirmation may then be bound once to either the canonical Songjiang turn or one exact private target, and retries of that exact binding reuse the same requestIntentId and job. Refusing later cross-Songjiang/private reuse prevents a confirmation reference from moving to a different disclosure and target context; it does not create a second job or break manager-to-chosen-chat durable intent replay.
